text:
maya: quick sync from pilot checkin — CS and the pilot customer asked for a very opinionated MVP: single Optimize toggle, sensible batching defaults, prefix/KV cache guidance, conservative quant path, and eval-triggered alerts in dry-run.
ryan: agree on minimal surface. suggest explicit request distribution for perf targets.
anita: MVP acceptance (proposal): p95 <= 150ms on short-chat mix (8–48 tokens), >=15% cost reduction on batchy traffic, quantized accuracy loss <=1% on customer eval, alerts in slack-dryrun for 7d.
sam: telemetry must be first-class: per-route cache_hit_rate, tokens_saved_pct, p95 by route, and a billing_delta tag. without these we cant prove wins.
maya: rollout plan: internal alpha -> single-customer pilot (red-team) -> open beta. dry-run alerts initially, then enable paging after noise window.
ryan: quant plan: MVP = INT8 dynamic; 4-bit behind opt-in flag only.
anita: SDK: Optimize boolean + advanced flags hidden. Console: one tile showing cache hit and tokens saved.
devops-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-mvp-alpha -> staging 2024-11-06T03:00Z. will notify #eng-releases.
maya: actions: anita draft playbook & acceptance checklist (EOD tomorrow); ryan scope runtime changes (2d); sam instrument telemetry schema (3d); maya onboard pilot (3d). reconvene after drafts.
